description: Read a Spool (the agreement object), including hash-covered evidence requirements, dispute policy, and salted unit identity configuration. Use for status checks; it has no side effects. A party named in who_may_dispute can supersede an issued receipt through POST /api/v1/receipts/{receipt_id}/supersede. There is no review queue or UI. Works in the no-key sandbox.
name: get_spool
title: Spool details
